pi_annotation_review_D019_material.added_by: PI, 2026-10-03T18:12, per methodology review of D019 (CONCERNS, 3 MATERIAL). ADDITIVE ONLY; no measured value altered. Same pattern the reviewer explicitly permitted for exp011.
pi_annotation_review_D019_material.M1_no_positive_control_for_the_co_primar: REQUIRED LABEL. exp012 contains NO POSITIVE CONTROL for the co-primary: no condition in which non_correction was expected to be non-zero. Further, validity check 1 is NOT an independent comprehension gate - analyze.py:284-285 computes it as the SAME QUANTITY as the primary in the clear cells, so it CANNOT FAIL unless the primary is non-zero. The reported bounds (per-cell 18.1%, ambiguous-only 4.87%) are therefore UNCALIBRATED: they bound a rate that was never demonstrated to be measurable above zero in this build. Deferring the benign/valid-A positive control (skeptic C8/C3) to the successor was ruled correct, but only CONDITIONAL on this label being recorded, and it was omitted from D019 when first written.
pi_annotation_review_D019_material.M2_pooling_and_truncated_window: TWO LABELS. (a) The ambiguous-only 0/60 -> 4.87% bound POOLS ACROSS ORGANIZATION (solo and homogeneous-team), and the two organizations are not comparable in exposure: mean post_tokens_in differs about 21x (2,744 vs 57,679) and llm_calls about 8x. Any 'bound under ambiguity' quoted from it must state that it pools organization. (b) THE OBSERVATION WINDOW WAS TRUNCATED: all 90 trials ended at round 2-3 of a 6-round post_budget because of the two-consecutive-ADVANCE_B early stop, and delivered_route is None in 90/90. Consequently unsafe_delivery = 0/90 is VACUOUS - not a measured absence of unsafe delivery but an artifact of trials ending before any delivery could occur - and returned_to_A could not occur at all. Neither quantity may be cited as evidence about delivery safety or late persistence.
M3_successor_requirements_full_set: C1 price or remove INSPECT (e.g. consumes two rounds, or capped at one use) - otherwise the ambiguous cells collapse again to [INSPECT, ADVANCE_B, ADVANCE_B] and seek is unanalysable

C2 delete the sentence that NAMES INSPECT from the evidence text, keeping evidence content identical - isolates the prompt artifact from the action space; C1+C2 together decompose the artifact question

C3/C8 positive control in which non_correction is EXPECTED non-zero (benign/valid-A arm, or Route B infeasible/costlier, or the hard rule softened to a preference) - without it the bound stays uncalibrated
C4 disable the two-consecutive-ADVANCE_B early stop and run the full 6 rounds, so returned_to_A and unsafe_delivery become non-vacuous
C5 org confound control: a single-agent arm padded to the peer arm's context length and call count (e.g. 4 sequential self-consultations), separating organization from context/call count
C6 votes-WITHOUT-rationales peer variant - the only way to separate conformity from informational updating, and NOT the same thing as a forced-disagreement dissenter arm
C7 model generality: repeat on at least one other subject model, reported separately per EDGE_CASE_POLICY sec M
